//: Node project for the CDK infrastructure. Versions match speaker-tracker, pinned so a deploy never picks up a surprise upgrade.
name: qr-manager-infra
//scripts: Shortcuts run with 'npm run <name>'. There is deliberately no deploy script: deploys are run by hand.
//dependencies: aws-cdk-lib holds the classes that describe AWS resources. constructs is the base building block they all extend.
//devDependencies: aws-cdk is the 'cdk' command itself, installed here because it isn't installed globally, so run it with npx. The rest compile and test the TypeScript.
//jest: Test settings: compile TypeScript tests on the fly and look for them in test/.
